definitions.explanation: Pitifully bad; causing or deserving pity; very unhappy.

examples.japanese: {惨|みじ}めな{気持|きも}ちになった。
{惨|みじ}めな{失敗|しっぱい}をした。
こんな{惨|みじ}めな{生活|せいかつ}は{嫌|いや}だ。
examples.english: I hate living such a wretched life.

notes:
{惨|みじ}め is a na-adjective describing a miserable, wretched, or pathetic state.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {惨|みじ}めな{生活|せいかつ} (wretched life)
- Adverb: {惨|みじ}めに{失敗|しっぱい}する (fail miserably)
- Noun form: {惨|みじ}めさ (wretchedness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {惨|みじ}めな{気持|きも}ち: miserable feeling
- {惨|みじ}めな{結果|けっか}: pitiful result
- {惨|みじ}めな{姿|すがた}: wretched appearance
- {惨|みじ}めな{思|おも}いをする: to feel miserable

USAGE:
Strongly negative. Can describe:
- Situations: {惨|みじ}めな{生活|せいかつ}
- Feelings: {惨|みじ}めになる (to become miserable)
- Self-reflection: often used about oneself during difficult times

SIMILAR:
- {哀|あわ}れ: pitiful, pathetic
- {情|なさ}けない: shameful, pathetic
